grade_age: Grade 8 (age 13-14) - deliberately borrowed one grade level up from this app's target age (9), same rationale as the already-merged MCAS Grade 8 Science Spring 2023 batch, specifically to source High Achiever-level reasoning content. This is a DIFFERENT administration (Spring 2025, paper-based test) than the already-merged Spring 2023 admin - confirmed distinct via the source URL/PDF (doe.mass.edu/mcas/2025/release/g8-ste.pdf vs .../2023/release/g8-ste.pdf) and distinct item content throughout.
verification_note: Checked doe.mass.edu/mcas/<year>/release/g8-ste.pdf for 2017-2025. 2018/2019/2022 returned 404. 2024 returned 200 but is a dead end for this pipeline's purposes: its cover page states 'The Department is not releasing items from the spring 2024 MCAS grades 3-8 tests' - the 2024 PDF contains only an item-description table (standard, reporting category, one-line description), no actual item text/options/answer key. 2025 returned 200 and IS a genuine full release: complete item stems, all four answer options, diagrams (described in text below), and a published correct-answer-letter table for all selected-response items. Used 2025.

deferred_reasons.10: Roller coaster GPE comparison (Part A: which of 4 carts W/X/Y/Z has most GPE; Part B: compare GPE of cart X vs cart Z). The diagram encodes both relative hill height AND rider presence (added mass) simultaneously, and the published answer to Part B ('same height' reasoning) glosses over the mass difference from riders in a way that can't be restated in text without either misrepresenting the diagram's geometry or reproducing an ambiguity the visual makes concrete. Too much risk of silently changing the intended comparison.
deferred_reasons.13: CO2-over-time graph, 'select three' multi-select item (5 options, 3 correct: B, C, E). This app's schema is single-correct-answer (4 options, one correctOption letter) - a genuine multi-select item doesn't fit without redesigning the item, which would go beyond a light rewrite. Deferred rather than forced into the wrong shape.
deferred_reasons.19: Rock-layer fault diagram (6 layers U-Z cut by a fault, asking which layer is youngest among those present when the fault formed). The spatial relationship between the fault line and each layer boundary is load-bearing for the answer and inherently visual - restating it in text risks fabricating the cross-cutting relationship rather than faithfully transcribing it.

items_skipped_constructed_response_or_un.8: Two-part open-ended explanation (snowshoe-hare camouflage + natural-selection prediction under climate change) - constructed-response, no fixed answer, excluded per the pipeline's standing no-fixed-answer rule.
items_skipped_constructed_response_or_un.9: Listed as a constructed-response item overall (force-diagram completion + explanation). Part A embeds a selected-response sub-question (choose the correct force-arrow model for block Z) - but the released answer table shades this item's answer column blank/gray, meaning MA DESE did not publish even the Part A answer for this item (unlike items 5, 7, 10, 15, which are also two-part SR items and DO have both sub-answers published, e.g. 'A;D', 'C;B'). Excluded because there is no official answer to check against.
items_skipped_constructed_response_or_un.17: Three-part open-ended explanation (bridge live loads, compression, tension) - constructed-response, no fixed answer.

two_part_items_split_for_extraction: Items 5, 7, and 15 are each a single MCAS item number containing two independently-answered selected-response sub-questions (both published in the answer key as e.g. 'A;D'). Each sub-question is extracted as its own separate item below (5a/5b, 7a/7b, 15a/15b) since each has its own 4-option set and its own single correct answer - this fits the pipeline's single-answer schema per sub-question without misrepresenting the source.
note: All 17 extracted items have official correct answers published in the document's Spring 2025 Released Operational Items answer-key table (page 26-27 of the source PDF). Constructed-response items have no published answer key ('Sample responses and scoring guidelines... will be posted... later this year' per the document) and were excluded on that basis in addition to being open-ended. Items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 15 reference a diagram/image, but for the 14 of those judged usable (all except 10), the diagram is illustrative/descriptive rather than load-bearing - the underlying relationship (wave amplitude comparison, ancient-seafloor geography, air-mass warm/cool interaction, food-web predator/prey and trophic-level relationships, population-cycle timing, magnetic attraction/repulsion between two bars, moon-phase mechanics) is fully describable in text, consistent with the judgment calls made in the Spring 2023 MCAS G8 batch already merged.
